keywords: Mirror (There is No Wind; Exalted, p. 187)
system.description:
The predator does not need to see its prey — it feels the heartbeat resonating through shadow and stone. The Abyssal attunes her senses to the vital rhythms of living targets, perceiving their heartbeat, breathing, and essence-pulse at ranges up to (Essence × 100) yards. Against a tracked target, the Exalted ignores all concealment, cover, and visibility penalties to her Awareness rolls and to ranged attack rolls, as her supernatural sense of the prey's location negates the need for direct line of sight.

This charm persists for a single action after activation, its duration precisely calibrated to the moment of release. It serves as a prerequisite for Flawless Archer Discipline, Piercing Ghost Barb, and Twisting Spiteful Shaft — the former requiring the perfect target-sense to function, the latter two requiring the Abyssal's awareness of vital points that only this intimate heartbeat-knowledge can provide.
